title: Project manual checks
description: A project's own checks file for the run-manual-checklist skill (default docs/checklist/checks.json). Owned by the project, never written by the scaffold. scripts/checklist.py check enforces the same rules plus anchor existence.

results-dir.description: Relative directory for dated run files.

rules.description: Project 'never' rules, printed by new-run; prose for the agent.

facts.description: Facts a run compares against, each derived by running its command from the repo root.

nonzero.description: Output 0 means the derivation is broken.

anchor.description: Repo-relative path[#fragment] of the document defining the behaviour.
